description: Run Fudge’s free SEO report on a Shopify store: a score out of 100 averaged from its page-two, missing-pages, AI-visibility and product-schema audits, which it runs together, and a short list of what to do first. It adds the store’s Google ranking counts, whether Google can read the store (robots.txt, home page title, theme files), buttons on the home page and one product page that lead nowhere, how its articles rank, real-visitor phone speed from the Chrome UX Report and one improved title previewed as a Google result. Free, no sign-in; waits up to 45 seconds, and the full report takes about 3–7 minutes. Shared per store for a day; anything not measured is reported as unknown.

country.description: The market to check, as a two-letter ISO country code such as GB. Omit it for the store’s main market.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: run_seo_report
title: SEO report
